channel.title: Concept Bytes
channel.description: Welcome to Concept Bytes! We love building cool things with electronics, robotics, and AI. From fun projects to solving real problems, we show you how to bring ideas to life with engineering. Join us and let's create something awesome together!

I built a WALKING coffee table
videos.desc:
Ever wondered if your coffee table could do more than just hold your coffee? In this video, we take a regular piece of furniture and give it the ability to walk! Thanks to Giliam De Carpentier and Theo Jenson, we’re building a coffee table that can follow you, grab your stuff, and more.

Thanks to Xtool for sponsoring this video! Check out their all new F1 Ultra: https://www.xtool.com/products/xtool-f1-ultra-20w-fiber-diode-dual-laser-engraver

I hope you enjoyed this video, if you are interested in supporting me making more videos check out my patreon at: https://www.patreon.com/c/ConceptByte
